title: CENTERPOINT ENERGY INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: CenterPoint Energy filed an 8-K disclosing results from its April 16, 2026 annual shareholder meeting, including election of 12 directors, ratification of Deloitte & Touche as auditor, approval of executive compensation, and approval of an amended certificate of formation providing limited officer exculpation under Texas law.
key_points: Twelve directors elected to one-year terms expiring at the 2027 annual meeting; all nominees received majority 'for' votes.
Deloitte & Touche LLP ratified as independent auditor for 2026 with 583.7M votes for (vs. 24.9M against).
Advisory executive compensation resolution approved with 560.2M votes for (vs. 17.8M against).
Amended and Restated Certificate of Formation approved with 350.9M votes for (vs. 226.8M against) — closest margin of all votes.
The certificate amendment provides limited officer exculpation as permitted under Texas law.
All voting totals include abstentions and broker non-votes; broker non-votes totaled 28.7M across all matters.
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate governance filing for a regulated utility (NYSE: CNP). It contains no market-moving information, no earnings data, no forward guidance, and no regulatory developments relevant to broader financial markets. The only marginally notable item is the closer vote on the officer exculpation charter amendment (61% for), which is a standard corporate law provision with no market impact.
